title: 第十七章 斗兽第十八章 接连打脸
lines: 第十七章斗兽事情一波三折，惨遭两家嘲讽，丹宝阁神秘出手，引来薛玉威逼，每一步都惊险刺激。
这一切都因为一个人，柳无邪！
薛玉的出手，在所有人看来，终于可以尘埃落定了，庞大的薛家，碾死徐家如同一只蝼蚁。
千钧一发之际，徐凌雪站起来，手里拿出一枚令牌，狠狠地拍在桌子上。
令牌上雕刻一枚九足鸟，象征着帝国学院，没有人可以仿造。
“她被帝国学院录取了，还被百里清收为弟子。”
人群炸开了锅，帝国学院是大燕皇朝最高学府，汇聚全国的精英天才，每年招收的名额极其有限，距离帝国学院招收还有几个月时间，她的令牌从何而来？
百里清的大名，早已传遍整个大燕皇朝，是帝国学院三大副院长之一，成为她的弟子，必能平步青云，成为一方巨擘。
加入帝国学院，那是一辈子的荣耀，是无数人必生追求的目标。
柳无邪脸上闪过一丝错愕，连他都不清楚，徐凌雪什么时候加入了帝国学院。
四方传来急促的呼吸声，多么希望他们也能成为帝国学院的一员，每年变态的考核，刷下去无数天才，他们只招收精英中的精英，不要废物。
“原来你就是百里清院长新招收的弟子。”
薛玉脸上的表情从震惊，变成惊讶，帝都城早就传出消息，百里清收了一名新弟子，一直不知此人是谁。
不经过考核，提前被副院长收为弟子，这种事情以前不是没发生过，无一不是妖孽般的天才，提前颁发帝国学院的令牌。
百里清极为骄傲，能被她看中的人不多，徐凌雪就是其中之一。
“刚才是我鲁莽了，还请徐姑娘不要介意，恰好我也被帝国学院录取，以后我们就是同学了，今天的事情，我给徐姑娘赔不是。”
薛玉的态度改变的很快，从怀里也拿出一枚帝国学院的令牌，跟徐凌雪拿出来的一模一样。
到了帝国学院，有的是办法接近徐凌雪，还怕没有机会吗。
万不同还有田野泉等人，像是吃了臭鸭蛋一样，脸上的表情，极其难看，对柳无邪的恨意更浓了。
一场闹剧，最终以这样的方式结局，是谁也没有料到，包括霍大师，看向徐凌雪的目光，多了一丝敬畏。
万家还有田家的弟子，各自落座，回到属于自己的区域，倒是松家小胖子大大咧咧的坐在柳无邪身边。
“谢谢刚才仗义执言。”
柳无邪微微一笑，小胖子能挺身而出，让他很惊讶，这样的人值得结交。
“我又没帮到什么忙，还是徐姐姐厉害，成为帝国学院的学员，将来腾飞了，可要记得我这个弟弟。”
松陵一副自来熟的样子，很快跟他们二人打成一片。
徐家跟松家关系相对较近一些，徐凌雪跟松陵见过几次面，两人一直以姐弟相称。
一声兽吼打断了所有人，从斗兽场中心地带传出，斗兽开始了。
“柳公子，跟我们坐一起吧，那边视线较好。”
霍大师走回来，他坐的位置跟薛玉很近，单独摆放的三张桌子，薛玉跟田野泉几人，低声交谈，偶尔朝这边看一眼。
“不用了，我坐这里挺好。”
柳无邪并未起身，今天的百妖会，他的兴趣不大。
最后时刻，万家家主，还有松家以及田家家主联袂而来，坐在霍大师旁边的桌子，三张桌子全部坐满。
斗兽场像是一座巨大的笼子，观赏者坐在四周，俯瞰地面，一座座斗兽擂台呈现在他们面前。
中间擂台上，站着一名老者，手里拿着扩音器：“欢迎大家参加我们万家举办的百妖会，跟往常一样，百妖会有两个环节，斗兽，跟驯兽。”
斗兽，顾名思义，放两头妖兽到擂台上，相互争斗，活下来的一方，即为胜者。
妖兽厮杀极为血腥，对于武者来说，血腥场面能提高他们的心理素质，将来面对这样的局面，倒不至于活活的吓死。
驯兽则不同，通过挑战的形式，驯服妖兽，或者降服妖兽，来达到历练的效果。
四大家族万家最为富有，驯兽场生意非常的火爆，他们提供各类妖兽为武者修炼。
进入山脉猎杀妖兽，危险性太大，弄不好小命丢在里面。
驯兽场则不同，不仅可以模拟真实环境，妖兽也是百分百真实，一旦有危险，驯兽师会第一时间出现。
当然，也有例外，妖兽狂性大发，吃掉驯兽者。
相比较而言，驯兽场的危险性已经降到最低，生意火爆到也正常。
“我们会安排十场斗兽，供应大家欣赏，跟往常一样，会设立一些小盘口，愿意参与赌兽的，你们每个人的桌子上，都有详细的介绍，不愿意参与赌兽，我们也不强求，大家玩的开心就好。”
content_en:
Chapter 17: The beast fight has twists and turns, and is ridiculed by two families. Danbao Pavilion makes a mysterious move, attracting Xue Yu's threats, and every step is thrilling.
All this is because of one person, Liu Wuxie!
Xue Yu's action, in everyone's eyes, finally settled the matter. The huge Xue family crushed the Xu family like an ant.
At the critical moment, Xu Lingxue stood up, took out a token in her hand, and slammed it on the table.
A nine-legged bird is engraved on the token, symbolizing the Imperial Academy and no one can imitate it.
"She was admitted to the Imperial Academy and was accepted as a disciple by Baili Qing."
The crowd exploded. Imperial College is the highest institution of learning in the Yan Dynasty, gathering elite talents from all over the country. The number of places recruited every year is extremely limited. There are still a few months until Imperial College enrollment. Where does her token come from?
Bailiqing's name has already spread throughout the Yan Dynasty. She is one of the three vice-presidents of the Imperial College. If she becomes her disciple, she will surely rise to the top and become a giant.
Joining Imperial College is a lifelong honor and a goal that countless people must pursue throughout their lives.
A trace of astonishment flashed across Liu Wuxie's face. Even he didn't know when Xu Lingxue joined the Imperial College.
There were rapid breathing sounds from all directions. How I wished they could become members of the Imperial Academy. Every year, they passed through perverted assessments and passed down countless geniuses. They only recruited the best of the best, not waste.
"It turns out that you are the newly recruited disciple of Dean Baili Qing."
The expression on Xue Yu's face changed from shock to surprise. News had long come out in the Imperial City that Baili Qing had accepted a new disciple, but he never knew who he was.
Being accepted as a disciple by the Vice-President in advance without going through the examination is something that has never happened before. They are all monster-like geniuses who are issued the Imperial Academy's token in advance.
Bailiqing is extremely proud, and there are not many people who can be favored by her, and Xu Lingxue is one of them.
"I was reckless just now, please don't mind Miss Xu. I happened to be admitted to Imperial College, and we will be classmates from now on. I will apologize to Miss Xu for what happened today."
Xue Yu's attitude changed quickly, and he took out an Imperial Academy token from his arms, which was exactly the same as the one Xu Lingxue took out.
After arriving at Imperial College, there are many ways to get close to Xu Lingxue, but are you afraid that you won't have a chance?
Wan Bing and Tian Tianquan and others looked as if they had eaten rotten duck eggs. The expressions on their faces were extremely ugly, and their hatred for Liu Wuxie became even stronger.
A farce would end in this way. No one expected it, including Master Huo, who looked at Xu Lingxue with a hint of awe.
The disciples of the Wan family and the Tian family each took their seats and returned to their own areas. On the other hand, the fat boy from the Song family sat carelessly next to Liu Wuxie.
"Thank you for speaking out just now."
Liu Wuxie smiled slightly. He was surprised that the little fat man could stand up. Such a person was worth making friends with.
"I haven't been of much help. Sister Xu is still great. She has become a student of the Imperial College and will take off in the future. You must remember my younger brother."
Song Ling looked familiar and quickly got along with the two of them.
The Xu family has a relatively close relationship with the Song family. Xu Lingxue and Song Ling have met several times, and they have always treated each other as brother and sister.
A beast roar interrupted everyone, and came from the center of the Colosseum, and the beast fight began.
"Mr. Liu, please sit with us. The view is better over there."
Master Huo came back. He was sitting very close to Xue Yu. At three separate tables, Xue Yu and Tian Tianquan were chatting in low voices and occasionally looking over here.
"No, I'm fine just sitting here."
Liu Wuxie did not get up. He was not very interested in the Hundred Demons Meeting today.
At the last moment, the heads of the Wan family, the Song family, and the Tian family came together and sat at the table next to Master Huo. All three tables were full.
The Colosseum is like a huge cage. The spectators sit around and overlook the ground, and the fighting arenas are presented in front of them.
On the middle stage, there was an old man standing with a loudspeaker in his hand: "Welcome everyone to join the Hundred Demons Meeting held by our Wan family. As usual, the Hundred Demons Meeting will have two parts, beast fighting and beast taming."
Beast fighting, as the name suggests, puts two monsters on the ring and fights each other. The one who survives is the winner.
The fight between monsters and beasts is extremely bloody. For warriors, bloody scenes can improve their psychological quality. When facing such a situation in the future, they will not be scared to death.
Beast taming is different. Through challenges, taming or subduing monsters can achieve the effect of experience.
The Wan family of the four major families is the richest, and the business of the animal training farm is very prosperous. They provide all kinds of monsters for the warriors to train.
It is too dangerous to enter the mountains to hunt monsters, and you may lose your life in it.
The animal training field is different. Not only can it simulate the real environment, but the monsters are also 100% real. If there is danger, the animal trainer will appear immediately.
Of course, there are exceptions. Monsters go crazy and eat their tamers.
In comparison, the dangers of the animal training farm have been reduced to a minimum, and it is normal for the business to be booming.
"We will arrange ten beast battles for everyone to enjoy. As usual, we will set up some small handicaps. If you are willing to participate in beast betting, there will be a detailed introduction on each of your tables. If you are not willing to participate in beast betting, we will not force it. Everyone can have fun."
title_en: Chapter 17: Fighting Beasts Chapter 18: Continuous Slaps in the Face
